_comment: Scoring weights and thresholds for Phase 3 matching. Tune here, not in code.

thresholds.min_score_description: Items scoring below this are marked '得分不足' and not written to Excel

weights.keyword_match_description: Per matched Chinese keyword from category_map
weights.no_keyword_penalty_description: Applied when category has keywords but none matched
weights.unit_type_mismatch_description: 项/LS vs physical unit (m/m2/m3/t) — different measurement concept
weights.unit_hard_mismatch_description: Completely different physical units (m vs m3, etc.)
weights.no_quota_unit_penalty_description: Quota item has empty unit field (often a data quality issue)
weights.manual_labor_penalty_description: 人力 items penalized for earthwork categories (prefer mechanical)
weights.cost_item_concrete_hit_description: BOQ mentions 砼/混凝土 AND quota cost_item has concrete materials
weights.cost_item_concrete_miss_description: BOQ mentions 砼/混凝土 BUT quota cost_item lacks concrete materials
weights.cost_item_rebar_hit_description: BOQ mentions 钢筋 AND quota cost_item has rebar materials
weights.cost_item_rebar_miss_description: BOQ mentions 钢筋 BUT quota cost_item lacks rebar materials
weights.cost_item_formwork_hit_description: BOQ mentions 模板 AND quota cost_item has formwork materials
weights.cost_item_formwork_miss_description: BOQ mentions 模板 BUT quota cost_item lacks formwork materials
weights.cost_item_steel_structure_hit_descriptio: BOQ mentions 钢结构 AND quota cost_item has steel materials
weights.cost_item_steel_structure_miss_descripti: BOQ mentions 钢结构 BUT quota cost_item lacks steel materials
weights.work_content_match_description: Process verb overlap between BOQ description and quota work_content
weights.attribute_match_description: Spec/grade info from BOQ (e.g. C40, diameter) matches attr_level fields

earthwork_prefer_mechanical.description: 土石方工程优先机械定额，匹配到人力定额时扣分
